messages.subject: Mercedes-Benz Thailand | Electric mobility, external affairs and country stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Schell and Mercedes-Benz Thailand Leadership Team,

Mercedes-Benz Thailand is entering a new leadership chapter while advancing electric mobility and local market transformation. That combination of transition, investment and stakeholder complexity is where my experience is strongest.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance, compliance and executive stakeholder strategy. I routinely manage issues that require alignment among senior leadership, regulators, technical teams, communities and external partners.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around a large solar and battery-storage program and carbon-data readiness using physical operational evidence. I also manage formal submissions, inspections, official engagements and reputation-sensitive matters across a heavily regulated industrial setting. This gives me a strong foundation for corporate affairs and country strategy in a mobility business undergoing rapid energy and policy change.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN responsibilities across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a Mercedes-Benz Thailand-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
